property_summary: For any successful fallback call, if block.timestamp > pastBlockTime and msg.value == 10 ether, the contract's balance must not exceed 0 after the call when block.number % 15 == 0, since the transfer should execute; the bug prevents transfer via revert, leaving balance > 0.
change_summary: Insert a selfdestruct or revert inside the if block so transfer never happens under the mod 15 condition.
